documents.title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
documents.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice (Legislative Department)
documents.effective_note: S.O. 2351(E) brought most provisions into force on 2020-07-20; S.O. 2421(E) brought the remainder into force on 2020-07-24.
amendment_chain: Insertion by Act 33 of 2021, s. 30 (w.e.f. 2021-04-04) at s. 58(1)(b), recorded in the India Code consolidated text.
notes: Gazette copy, 40 pages.

Confirm whether any post-2021 amendment exists before human_verified.

documents.title: The Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020 and the Consumer Protection (General) Rules, 2020
documents.effective_note: CCR 2020 (G.S.R. 448(E)) and General Rules 2020 (G.S.R. 449(E)) both state 2020-07-20.
amendment_chain: CCR 2020 rule 7(2) table substituted by G.S.R. 892(E) (2022), then again by G.S.R. 606(E) (2023).
notes: Two instruments in one 18-page gazette PDF: English parts start at page 9.
The 2023 amendment is the current fee table; the principal text alone is stale.

documents.title: The Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Amendment Rules, 2022
documents.effective_note: The rules say they come into force on the date of publication in the Official Gazette. The notification dateline is 2022-12-20, but the gazette masthead is 2022-12-21, so the publication date is 2022-12-21.
notes: Substitutes the rule 7(2) fee table.
Superseded on that point by the 2023 amendment.
The Hindi text layer has broken glyph mapping; the English text extracts cleanly.
The 2023 amendment refers to this instrument as 'dated 21st December 2022'; the dateline says 20th December and the gazette masthead says 21st December.

documents.title: The Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) (Amendment) Rules, 2023
documents.effective_note: In force on the date of publication in the Official Gazette.
notes: Substitutes the rule 7(2) fee table; this is the current table.
Its own note says the principal rules were last amended by G.S.R. 892(E), dated 21st December 2022 (the notification is dated 20 December).

documents.title: The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
documents.effective_note: In force on the date of publication in the Official Gazette.
notes: 11 pages; English part starts at page 7.
The principal text alone is not the current law.

documents.title: Corrigendum to the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
documents.effective_note: The document has no commencement clause. Its dateline is 2020-08-04; the gazette masthead is 2020-08-05. No effective date is stated, so none is recorded.
documents.correction: Pages 8-10: replaces the Devanagari clause labels (क), (ख), (ग), (घ), (ङ), (च) with (a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (f).
notes: No substantive change to the English text.
Dateline 2020-08-04, gazette masthead 2020-08-05.
